item.title: Opinion | Don’t clear the field in governor’s race by clearing out diversity
item.description: Most candidates urged to stay are white and backed by big money, but those urged to bow out are leaders of color with decades of public service. It's an issue in this state of diverse voters.

item.title: California sues Trump to keep shut oil pipeline on Santa Barbara coast
item.description: The state argues the Trump administration invented an energy emergency to justify forcing the restart of a shuttered offshore oil operation — setting a dangerous precedent for federal power over state law.

item.title: Opinion | Government money made Silicon Valley’s tech titans rich. A billionaire tax won't hurt them
item.description: The public helped create tech fortunes via government grants, defense contracts and corporate-friendly regulation. Some payback is in order.

item.title: Does lobbying at the Capitol work? These UC students say yes, and they’ve got receipts
item.description: University students lobbied at the California Capitol recently, backing bills to increase CalFresh eligibility, student housing and voting student regents.

item.title: Opinion | Medi-Cal faces funding emergency from state miscalculations, federal budget cuts
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom is retracting Medi-Cal for immigrants, years after he wrongly figured a state surplus. And President Trump is cutting health funds to states.

item.title: Digital tablets mellowed California prisons. Now a tech migration is riling users
item.description: Every incarcerated person in a California prison has a digital table enabling communication with the outside world. The system is changing vendors to lower costs.

item.title: Last-minute voter? The Supreme Court is coming for you
item.description: Justices could set a precedent in a decision about Mississippi ballots postmarked on Election Day but arriving after.

item.title: Court denies California's bid to halt Riverside sheriff's recount of 2025 election ballots
item.description: Chad Bianco, a Republican sheriff running for governor, seized ballots for a voter fraud investigation. California is asking a court to halt the inquiry.

item.title: Exclusive: Rape calls at ICE detention center aren't investigated by San Diego sheriff's officecenter
item.description: The warden at an immigrant detention center in San Diego County has authority to decide how to investigate rape reports there under an agreement with the local sheriff's office.

item.title: Opinion | California governor's race gets weirder with debate cancellation, new poll
item.description: USC cancelled its debate amid allegations of bias because all the invited candidates are white while candidates of color were not invited.

item.title: Opinion | AI reminded me to lead in my classroom, not follow someone else’s dictates
item.description: This change isn’t just about technology. It’s about whether teachers reclaim their role as designers of learning or wait to be told what to do next.

item.title: Feds ramp up scrutiny in yearslong dispute over California airport money
item.description: The FAA wants California to prove it’s allocating jet fuel tax revenue to aviation. Hundreds of millions of dollars are at stake.

item.title: A new homelessness strategy is sweeping California
item.description: Homelessness prevention shows promising results in California, as advocates push to spread it statewide and nationally.

item.title: CA Democratic governor hopefuls not bowing out
item.description: The crowded Democratic primary field refuses to winnow, boosting chances of a Republican as the next California governor.

item.title: California hid hazardous waste records from the public. Here's why it matters
item.description: State regulators buried key hazardous waste documents — then gave the public a broken link and told them to file a records request.
